settings.intro_highlight: A professional treatment chair for facials and hair removal, with an adjustable headrest, 15° tilt and a height range of 20.5 to 36.5 inches.
settings.custom_description: The Ultra-Comfort 20500 is the 24-inch model in the Ultra-Comfort range. Its manually adjustable backrest and legrest support positioning for facial and depilation treatments, while the adjustable headrest helps support the client.
settings.subtitle: Positioning and comfort for treatment sessions
settings.secondary_description: Ultra-white, ultra-resistant leatherette covers the chair. Removable ergonomic armrests and casters are optional accessories. Color Chart A lists the range’s upholstery options; the selectors below show the variant currently offered on this product page.

settings.question: Facial and depilation positioning
settings.answer: An adjustable headrest, manually adjustable backrest and legrest, and 15° tilt help position the client for facial and hair-removal treatments.

settings.question: Height and model width
settings.answer: The listed height range is 20.5 to 36.5 inches. This product is model 20500 with a 24-inch width; the 26-inch Ultra-Comfort is a separate catalog model.

settings.question: Upholstery and optional accessories
settings.answer: The chair has ultra-resistant leatherette upholstery. Removable ergonomic armrests and casters are optional; they are not stated as included equipment.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Set the chair elevation to suit the treatment and practitioner, within the listed 20.5–36.5 in range.
Adjust these sections manually to position the client for the treatment.
Adjust the headrest for the client’s positioning before beginning the service.
Use the 15° tilt function as appropriate for facial and neck access.
Keep the client centrally supported and follow the supplied operating instructions for all adjustments.
Use non-abrasive cleaning products suitable for the upholstery, following the manufacturer’s care instructions.
Contact Equipro for maintenance and repair guidance.

settings.question: What is the height range of the Ultra-Comfort 20500?
settings.answer: The listed adjustable height range is 20.5 to 36.5 inches.

settings.question: Does the chair have a tilt function?
settings.answer: Yes. Canada PRO V1.2 lists a 15° tilt for the Ultra-Comfort range.

settings.question: Is this the 24-inch or 26-inch Ultra-Comfort?
settings.answer: This product is model 20500, with a 24-inch width and current variant SKU 20500-24W. The PDF lists the 26-inch version separately under model 20501.

settings.question: Are armrests and casters included?
settings.answer: The PDF lists removable ergonomic armrests and casters as optional accessories.

settings.question: What upholstery is used?
settings.answer: Ultra-white, ultra-resistant leatherette. Color Chart A shows the catalog’s upholstery options; the product selectors show the currently offered variant.

settings.question: What warranty is listed for model 20500?
settings.answer: Canada PRO V1.2 lists a two-year warranty for Ultra-Comfort 20500/20501.
